title: Axiamatic, which offers an "agentic control plane" to manage large-scale enterprise transformations, emerges from stealth with $54M from Greylock and Bessemer (Lily Mae Lazarus/Fortune)
summary: Lily Mae Lazarus / Fortune: Axiamatic, which offers an “agentic control plane” to manage large-scale enterprise transformations, emerges from stealth with $54M from Greylock and Bessemer — Enterprise transformations are one of the biggest line items in corporate budgets—and one of the easiest ways to light money on fire.
